<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="Record page 3 column layout">426a984e79c0df54c34eb56e1a47c582</macroponent><name>On Gen AI Eligibility Check</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {any} params.event
 * @param {any} params.imports
 * @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function handler({
    api,
    event,
    helpers,
    imports
}) {
    if (api.state.isGenAiSuggested)
        return;

    if (event.name === 'DATA_FETCH_SUCCEEDED') {
        var answer = api.data.check_gen_ai_eligibility_1.output;
        if (answer.eligible && !api.state.isGeneratingMergeDuplicates && !api.context.props.duplicateSysIds) {
            helpers.modal.open('modal_gen_ai');
            var filters = [];
            for (var f in answer.availableTaskFilters) {
                filters.push({
                    id: f,
                    label: answer.availableTaskFilters[f].label
                });
            }
            api.setState('availableTaskFilters', filters);
            const defaultFilter = filters.length ? filters[0] : {};
            api.setState('defaultTaskFilters', [defaultFilter.id]);
            if (defaultFilter.id) {
                api.setState('searchFilters', defaultFilter.id);
            }
            
            api.setState('isGenAiSuggested', true);
        }
        if (answer.timeout) {
            api.setState('genAiTimeout', answer.timeout);
        }
    }
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>felipe.valenca</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-21 16:26:42</sys_created_on><sys_id>2a6ad84e79c0df54c34eb56e1a47c526</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>On Gen AI Eligibility Check</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Escola Virtual" source="x_fub_fundbrad_ev">e56ecca5ecff031463f173bdfd6dd941</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Escola Virtual">e56ecca5ecff031463f173bdfd6dd941</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_2a6ad84e79c0df54c34eb56e1a47c526</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>felipe.valenca</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-21 16:26:42</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>
